incidents.symptom: Kilo exited successfully while its JSON event stream contained a provider/model error and no usable edit.
incidents.cause: The custom gateway used the wrong AI SDK adapter for chat completions and did not register the gateway model explicitly.
incidents.decision: Use @ai-sdk/openai-compatible for chat_completions, retain @ai-sdk/openai for responses, register the selected gateway model, and reject JSON error events even when the process exit code is zero.

incidents.symptom: A non-interactive Kilo run waited on an interactive suggest/question path until timeout.
incidents.cause: The generated headless agent policy still exposed interactive tools.
incidents.decision: Deny suggest, question, and plan tools in the headless agent and recover usage from Kilo's database on timeout.

incidents.symptom: Identical valid candidates produced NaN explained-variance diagnostics; PostgreSQL rejected the JSONB snapshot, while the in-memory manager still exposed the uncommitted candidate to scheduling.
incidents.cause: Zero-variance PCA diagnostics were not normalized and ingestion failure did not restore the manager from the durable snapshot in the same transaction.
incidents.decision: Normalize non-finite projection diagnostics to zero and reload the affected island from the durable snapshot before recording ingestion failure.

incidents.symptom: Dramatiq --use-spawn raised RuntimeError: context has already been set.
incidents.cause: Queued Loguru logging initialized the multiprocessing context before the worker pool unconditionally requested --use-spawn.
incidents.decision: Request --use-spawn only when no start method exists; otherwise reuse the initialized context.

incidents.symptom: The first ready island consumed normal-job budget before the second island had completed its seed population, yielding a 5/3 target split.
incidents.cause: Normal scheduling began as soon as any island had a usable front.
incidents.decision: Hold normal scheduling until every configured island has a non-empty front.

incidents.symptom: Both migration jobs targeted beta because a global every-second-job cadence aliased with two-island round-robin scheduling.
incidents.cause: Migration eligibility used the global scheduled-job ordinal instead of a target-island-local ordinal.
incidents.decision: Count migration cadence independently per target island and rotate donors by migration round.

incidents.symptom: Eight complete Kilo usage events contained 640030 tokens but persisted provider-reported cost 0, bypassing the configured pricing table.
incidents.cause: The OpenAI-compatible gateway leaves Kilo's provider cost field at zero; Loreley treated every present provider cost as authoritative.
incidents.decision: For non-empty Kilo usage only, allow an explicit matching pricing rule to replace a zero cost placeholder; preserve positive provider costs.

incidents.symptom: After the only job failed, the exhausted scheduler raised SchedulerError because no retained candidate could supply the primary-objective branch.
incidents.cause: The terminal deliverable hook was named 'if possible' but treated an empty archive as a fatal configuration error.
incidents.decision: Skip the primary-objective branch with an explicit warning when no candidate was retained, then stop normally at the configured job limit.
